_comment: AirTAK — Airsoft Team Awareness Kit | firmware/boards/heltec_v4.json
_pin_reference: Pin mapping derived from meshtastic/firmware variants/esp32s3/heltec_v4/variant.h and Heltec-Aaron-Lee/WiFi_Kit_series pins_arduino.h, verified 2026-05-28.
_hardware: Heltec WiFi LoRa 32 V4. ESP32-S3R2 (16MB flash, 2MB PSRAM). SX1262 sub-GHz LoRa, SSD1306 128×64 OLED (I2C), Vext peripheral power control, battery ADC with voltage divider.
name: Heltec WiFi LoRa 32 V4

_pin_mapping._note: Heltec V4 pin map. SSD1306 OLED (I2C on 17/18), SX1262 LoRa on SPI (SCK=9, MISO=11, MOSI=10, CS=8). Vext (GPIO 36, active low) powers peripherals. Battery divider on GPIO 1 with ADC_CTRL (GPIO 37, active HIGH). KCT8103L FEM control is defined in BoardConfig.h.
_pin_mapping.OLED_SDA: GPIO 17  — I2C SDA for SSD1306 OLED
_pin_mapping.OLED_SCL: GPIO 18  — I2C SCL for SSD1306 OLED
_pin_mapping.VEXT: GPIO 36  — peripheral power (OLED + LoRa boost), active LOW
_pin_mapping.ADC_CTRL: GPIO 37  — battery ADC control, active HIGH
_pin_mapping.BUTTON: GPIO 0   — BOOT button, active LOW (needs pullup)
